notes.title: Meet the Gaucho and the Grassland.
notes.content:
If you enjoy playing [b]Goroons[/b], you have to check out a preview of our latest release, [b]Gaucho and the Grassland[/b]. It already features a [b]free demo version available[/b] on Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32674630/2399e9045b04d2cc0dc92b932fbb3b6e4b2c729e.png[/img]

[b]Gaucho and the Grassland[/b] offers an incredible experience through the fields of Rio Grande do Sul, filled with adventures alongside two loyal companions, Cusco and Alazão, who are inseparable and assist in building the farm. Alazão helps with exploration and herding, while Cusco, with his keen sense of smell, uncovers hidden items.

- Explore a mystical world through a magical portal, completing quests, collecting special items, helping local characters, and receiving rewards. 

- Interact with animals in various ways, such as roping bulls or taking cows to the marketplace to obtain useful items essential for generating resources and progressing in the game.

- Discover legends from the folklore of South America, such as the Boitatá, a fire snake that corrupts environments, and the Negrinho do Pastoreio, who provides hints to solve mysteries.

- Have the freedom to create your farm by acquiring land and building everything from scratch, in the best countryside style.

[b]Check out the Gaucho and the Grassland demo now and welcome to the pampas.[/b]
